Hi Emily / Carlos —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our mutual action plan review, attaching an updated MAP and SOW that fold in the evaluation milestones and the final QA gate language we discussed. High-level ask: confirm the approvers and a target ink window so we can schedule the provisioning and onboarding kickoff.

Key items in this package:
- Evaluation acceptance criteria (perf targets, sample prompts) — QA gate must be green before provisioning.
- Signatory routing: Atlas Finance -> Legal -> Ops.
- Proposed activation: provisioned infra + security attestation, then customer kickoff within 5 business days of final signature.

Attachments: [attachment: MAP_v2_AtlasRetail.pdf (PDF, 42KB)], [attachment: SOW_Redwood-Inference_Atlas_Retail.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm final approver list + email for DocuSign routing by EOD Wed (2026-12-02).
2) We schedule a 30-min go/no-go call for Fri 12/04 10:00 PT to walk the QA checklist and confirm start date.
3) Once signed, Redwood provisions dedicated capacity and schedules onboarding; ETA kickoff by Tue 12/08 if sign by 12/04.

If the doc routing needs to go to anyone else (IT security, procurement), flag now and we will add them to the flow.

Thanks —
